interpretation: Same-model explicit revision is neither an independent checker nor an isolated causal comparison. No control third-turn paraphrase and no repeat samples. Changes cannot establish a general repair rate. New human numerical grades remain blank. Compare useful outputs, added latency/cost, unresolved failures and regressions before considering any other intervention.
